ambience.text: Cold night wind blowing softly around the top of a tall stone clock tower, distant city hum far below, calm and wide, no music

drone.text: Dark mysterious cinematic ambient drone, low warm pad with a faint shimmering high texture, night, slow, no beat

tick_a.text: One single sharp tick of a giant antique brass tower clock escapement, crisp metallic click with a wooden thump, close and dry, isolated

tick_b.text: One single deep tock of a giant antique tower clock, heavy brass and oak clunk, close and dry, isolated

tick_c.text: A single loud mechanical clock tick, big brass escapement wheel locking, sharp transient, isolated, no reverb

gears.text: Inside a giant clock tower mechanism, huge brass gears and cogs slowly turning, rhythmic clicking ratchets, creaking oak beams, low metallic hum

whoosh.text: Deep cinematic whoosh rushing forward through a pane of glass, airy swoosh with a soft shimmering glass texture

clunk.text: Heavy iron clock mechanism clunk as a big lever drops, then a fast ratcheting whirr of gears winding up, tower clock striking train releasing

bell_a.text: One single massive bronze cathedral bell strike at midnight, deep powerful bong with a long rich shimmering reverberating decay

bell_b.text: A huge old church tower bell struck once by a hammer, enormous deep bong, long humming bronze resonance slowly fading

impact.text: Deep cinematic sub bass boom impact with a long low rumbling tail, trailer hit

birds.text: A flock of pigeons suddenly bursting into flight together, many wings flapping loudly, scattering into the night air

riser.text: Dark cinematic tension riser, low strings and sub swell slowly building louder toward a big hit
